implementedContract.appOwnedSetting: The RetroArch app definition owns the boolean setting video_threaded, with an authored default of false. Generated configuration writes that value.
implementedContract.recipeSourceSelector: One Rust resolver supplies the effective source to planning and the input description. RecipeDefault none retains legacy saved uploaded-file and managed-setting inference. Explicit none with stale saved source data is a conflict.
implementedContract.sourceExclusivity: Rust rejects stale saved bindings and contradictory source selections. Explicit none with stale source data produces no plan. Choosing a source in the UI clears bindings for other modes, while raw values and binding provenance remain available.
implementedContract.uploadedBytes: The supplied file bytes are captured once, hashed, and preserved without content changes or execution-time rereads.
implementedContract.createOperation: Both source modes use the same reviewed create-only operation. The final target is opened with openat(O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC); execution consumes the frozen bytes and never overwrites an existing target.
implementedContract.absenceAuthority: The target identity and confirmed-absence precondition are included in the reviewed artifact before digest finalization.
implementedContract.writeSafety: Descriptor-anchored parent traversal, selected-root identity checks, T03 drift checks, file and directory synchronization, and exact final readback are retained. EEXIST leaves existing bytes untouched. Partial writes, lost responses, hash mismatches, and cleanup uncertainty have distinct truthful outcomes.
implementedContract.launchOrdering: When a configuration source is selected, the planner orders seed_retroarch_cfg before the optional final launch_retroarch step. With no configuration source, the existing optional launch graph is retained.
implementedContract.bootstrap: The existing bootstrap lifecycle is preserved. An earlier RetroArch launch may create retroarch.cfg before the selected configuration step; T13a then blocks on the existing target and leaves it untouched.
implementedContract.videoThreaded: The generated value video_threaded=false is explicit EmuChef-authored configuration. It is not asserted to be the selected Android build's runtime default, and no T11 recommendation behavior was added.
implementedContract.configurationOnlyRecipe: The separately selectable app.retroarch.configure recipe creates or accepts a configuration for an already installed RetroArch app. It omits install, bootstrap launch, asset copy, and core provisioning actions. The existing app.retroarch.provision recipe retains its install, launch, mandatory copy_assets, and optionality behavior.
implementedContract.configurationOnlyTarget: The configuration-only recipe resolves the existing app-owned RetroArch config target. It uses the same reviewed create-only operation as provisioning and blocks an existing target without changing it.
implementedContract.sourceModePresentation: Rust owns the effective source projection. Choosing managed or uploaded preserves that selected source binding and clears only inactive-mode bindings; choosing none clears both source bindings. Explicit none with stale bindings remains a backend conflict unless the user explicitly clears them.
implementedContract.existingTargetClassification: The helper's create-only operation checks the anchored target without following symlinks and returns the existing-target status for entries present before the final open or created in the O_EXCL race. Errors after creation remain partial or uncertain.
